description: Opt-in glassbox hooks. UserPromptSubmit adds graph context to code prompts (ambient option). Stop checks the turn's diff once and can ask for one more look at High risk lines (gate option). PostToolUse and SessionStart keep the graph and the AGENTS.md block fresh (enable_hooks option). SessionStart also runs auto-init (auto_init option, on by default): in any git repo without a glassbox graph it starts building the code graph in the background (parsing only, no model calls), and in a repo with one it adds a short code map. The other hooks do nothing in a repo without a graph. None of them ever fails the turn.
